sections.heading: In-Game Description
sections.text:
A tattered, blood-covered note written by Dosaku, the surgeon in the Abandoned Dungeon.
At the bottom of the Mibu Village pond, you will find a sakura carp.
You will know it from its red eyes,
Which are said to never rot,
I require those red eyes.
Dosaku

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text:
Since the Red-Eyed Carp that drops the Red Carp Eyes is found at the bottom of the pond in Mibu Village, it can only be killed after obtaining the Mibu Breathing Technique by defeating the Corrupted Monk.
After the task is fulfilled, Doujun will give Sekiro a Lump of Grave Wax [x2].
